note: No system prompt: tools are exposed to a browser agent through WebMCP, so there is no server-side model call.

labels.what: Hardcoded sample customers (example.com), orders, items, DemoExpress shipments and one past case, held in module arrays
All eight tools run against the in-memory arrays in lib/data.ts, not a database or order system; state resets on restart and resetDemo wipes it
Same sample rows as SQL seed; the app never reads Supabase
Schema creates six tables with no row level security and no policies; customer data tables unprotected if this schema is used with Supabase
POST /api/cases has no user auth. Anyone can call prepare to get a confirmation token, then cancel any order or open a case for any customer_id. The token is not bound to an action, order or customer
Public reset action wipes demo orders, cases and audit log
GET /api/audit returns the audit log, including tool inputs and results, with no auth
Customer profile (name, email, phone) returned for any customer_id with no auth; orders and tools routes are the same
cancel_order checks status processing only; no ownership check that the order belongs to the customer
create_support_case does not check the order belongs to customer_id and takes free-text description with no length limit
Three 250 ms setTimeout waits between agent steps to look like thinking
Confirmation tokens kept in a process-memory Map; fails on serverless or more than one instance
